solution_summary: Cognizant, one of the world's leading professional services companies, works with businesses to make everyday life even better—for their employees, their customers, and the communities they serve. GoPerform includes essential components such as goal setting, regular performance reviews, and continuous manager feedback. But Cognizant wanted to take performance management to new heights by making it more intelligent, more meaningful, and even more effective. GoPerform includes essential components such as goal setting, regular performance reviews, and continuous manager feedback. Cognizant collaborated with Microsoft to implement the solution. Using training data provided by the company's Human Resources department, the team created a vector-based Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model to check each manager comment for effectiveness. The implementation centers on Azure Machine Learning, Excel, Azure to support document processing workflows.
